mobile deletion source used only to understand the destructive action surface
no issues, discussions, PRs or bug history before Phase B/C freeze
raw_signal_observation: deleteCollectionById wraps database deletion in prisma.$transaction but performs non-database side effects inside that callback: removeFolder deletes archive directories and Meilisearch deleteDocuments removes indexed documents before the transaction has necessarily committed. Those side effects are not rolled back by Prisma if a later database step fails.
material_claim: The collection-delete path has a repository-local atomicity boundary mismatch: a later database failure can roll back database state while already-performed filesystem/search side effects remain changed. A repair must preserve consistency across database, archive filesystem, and search index rather than treating the Prisma transaction as covering all three.
neta_next_move: Add a failure-injection test around collection deletion that forces a database failure after at least one external side effect, then implement the smallest consistency repair that makes the test red-before/green-after (for example compensation or post-commit/outbox handling rather than assuming Prisma can roll back filesystem/search state).
reversal_condition: If the external helpers are proven transactional/compensating through an integration fixture, or deletion is already protected by an outer durable workflow not visible in this path, withdraw the build recommendation.
baseline_decision: BUILD: move filesystem and search-index cleanup out of the Prisma transaction and perform them after the database delete succeeds so rollback cannot leave the database pointing at deleted archives.

evidence: Post-freeze issue search found real destructive-operation and preservation failures, including #900 and #1064, but neither reproduces the collection-delete transaction boundary under adjudication.

Issue #1064 independently shows that preserved-format reliability is a real product concern, but its archive-fetch failures are a neighboring mechanism and do not confirm rollback inconsistency during collection deletion.
adjudication.decision_delta: NO_MATERIAL_DIFFERENCE: both Neta and baseline recommend a local engineering repair; independent issue evidence does not adjudicate the exact atomicity mechanism.
adjudication.lesson: Static code can establish a non-atomic boundary between DB and external side effects, but issue-level evidence about preservation reliability cannot be promoted into confirmation of the specific rollback failure. The failure-injection gate remains the cheapest missing evidence.
